retrievalProfile.description: A gritty 90s-style digital collage featuring low-poly martial arts characters overlaid on textured backgrounds with aggressive, jagged typography and a distinct vertical sidebar.
excludeWhen: modern flat vector art is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A layered composition featuring a central low-poly 3D warrior in a dynamic pose, set against a background of enlarged, desaturated facial features and traditional textures, framed by a solid vertical black bar on the left containing vertical text.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground character vs. background facial close-up
Vertical sidebar vs. square main image area
Jagged, aggressive typography vs. geometric character forms
Warm character lighting vs. dark, textured background
coreInvariants: Vertical black sidebar on the left edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central low-poly warrior, mid-action, occupying 60% of the main square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The warrior's torso and the bright white of the gi/clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the vertical sidebar on the left, across the top title, down to the central figure, and finally to the bottom subtext.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with textures and overlapping layers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the background and sidebar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale greens in the character's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow-to-red gradients in the top typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast on the subject; low saturation in the background to create depth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Jagged, aggressive display type with sharp, thorn-like terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Vertical strokes are thick and irregular
Terminals end in sharp points or hooks
Horizontal bars are often angled or broken
High internal tension in glyph shapes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'E' and 'L' have elongated, claw-like horizontal strokes
Vertical text in the sidebar is rotated 90 degrees clockwise
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent jagged style across all text elements to maintain a unified 'street' or 'martial arts' theme.
graphicDevices: Vertical black bar on the left
Halftone or scanline textures in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the jagged, aggressive energy of the original lettering.
Matches the martial arts theme, though the original is more stylized and jagged.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square digital collage. On the left, a solid black vertical bar. In the main square, a low-poly 3D samurai character in a dynamic sword-fighting pose. The background should feature a large, faded, desaturated close-up of a face (eyes visible) and textured patterns resembling old paper or scanlines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add aggressive, jagged display text at the top center with a yellow-to-red vertical gradient. Add white vertical text inside the left black bar, rotated 90 degrees. Add smaller yellow jagged text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is there a vertical black bar on the left?
Is the central character low-poly in style?
Does the top text have a yellow-to-red gradient?
Is the typography jagged and aggressive?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sidebar text is vertically oriented.
Verify the low-poly aesthetic is consistent across the character.
Check that the background face does not overpower the central figure.
Confirm the typography maintains a 'thorned' or 'jagged' edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Low-Poly Character] + [Vertical Sidebar Layout] + [Jagged Brush Typography] + [Textured Collage Background] to create a 90s hip-hop martial arts aesthetic.
